title: How to Make an Event Interesting

cards.prompt: What qualities should an event's MC have?
cards.answer: Interesting, engaging, and uplifting, with few filler words and confident body gestures.

cards.prompt: An MC wants every audience member to feel involved. What ice breaking trick did DevFest Bandung use?
cards.answer: The MC asked the three people with the most coins in their pockets to come to the stage for merchandise, so everyone started counting coins.

cards.prompt: A good event should spend most of its time on promotion.
cards.answer: Myth: add real content instead of promotion with nothing actually said.

cards.prompt: Which is the top priority when planning an event?
cards.answer: Audience experience is the top priority; people like free stuff and hate hassle.

cards.prompt: How can audience flow reduce cognitive effort at an event?
cards.answer: Put clear signs for navigation, such as where the toilet is, so people don't have to think.

cards.prompt: To keep the audience happy, reduce waiting ____.
